{{Quote|TS units are in great demand on colony worlds in the Outer Rim. A shipper looking to make a nice, legitimate run with minimal risk can probably pick up a bunch of these and deliver them to some grateful colonists (at a healthy mark-up, of course).|[[Indigo]]|<ref name="CFTD" />}}
The '''TS-Arach series Pest Control Droid''' was a model of [[Class five droid/Legends|fifth-degree]] [[pest-control droid]] manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]].

==Characteristics==
A model of [[Class five droid/Legends|class five droid]], the TS-Arach series Pest Control Droid was a small [[Droid/Legends|droid]], with a width of 0.3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. Featuring four [[Limb/Legends|legs]], it was equipped with a single [[Human/Legends|Human]] range [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]], capable of also seeing in micro-scale, and a pair of [[Audio sensor/Legends|auditory receptors]], one of which was Human range, the other high-frequency, and a simple [[Personality matrix/Legends|personality matrix]]. The TS-Arach was armed with a small [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], as well as [[pesticide dispenser]]s. It was capable of functioning in virtually any environment.<ref name="CFTD" />

==Role==
The TS-Arach was designed to eradicate common pests that threatened crops. Using its [[Life-form scanner/Legends|lifeform sensor]] coupled with an [[entomology database]], the TS-Arach could identify individual creatures and determine if they were a threat to the crops the droid was assigned to patrol. Once a harmful creature was discovered, the TS-Arach dealt with the intrusion using its blaster and pesticide dispensers. If the creature was deemed harmless, its presence was logged and reported to the [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]].<ref name="CFTD" />

==History==
Manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]], the TS-Arach series Pest Control Droid cost 600 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="CFTD" /> Just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] introduced a completely redesigned version of its [[BT-16 perimeter droid]] that borrowed heavily from the pest-control droid's design.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the TS-Arach was in great demand on colony worlds located in the galaxy's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="CFTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The TS-Arach series Pest Control Droid was first mentioned in ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] supplement written by [[Drew Campbell]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''<ref name="CFTD" /> and released on [[April 1]], [[1997]],<ref name="Droids">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/6495|text=Droids}}</ref> where it was depicted in an illustration by [[Johannes Huber]].<ref name="CFTD" />
